name: Sheet Metal Inc.
old_description: Sheet Metal Inc. was founded in 1972 by Howard Letts and, over the course of fifty years, SMI has become a landmark name in the industry and known as one of Alaska’s premier sheet metal contractors.
about:
Sheet Metal Inc. was founded in 1972 by Howard Letts in Anchorage, Alaska. The family-owned business has operated for over fifty years, with Howard's grandson Jim Letts taking over operations in 2008. In 2018, the company acquired H&K Sheet Metal Fabricators, expanding its capabilities as a full-service design-build mechanical contractor.

The company provides design, fabrication, and full mechanical installation services. Its capabilities include custom metal fabrication, commercial HVAC and plumbing systems, preventative maintenance, facility automation and DDC controls, refrigeration, medical gas systems, air and hydronic balancing, and commercial kitchen design and installation. The firm employs union-affiliated sheet metal workers, plumbers, and service technicians with various certifications.

Sheet Metal Inc. serves commercial and industrial markets in Alaska, including HVAC, plumbing, controls, and service sectors. Customers range from facility owners needing custom fabrication — such as an aluminum boat cover for a private client — to large-scale commercial projects requiring integrated mechanical systems.

The company's mission emphasizes professional, reliable, and responsive service, aiming to meet every schedule and budget while delivering high-quality craftsmanship. Its differentiation lies in offering a single-source solution for design, fabrication, and installation, backed by union-trained personnel and in-house engineering support.
